subject: Re: Quick demo / fit questions for BrightLane
messages:
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@brightlane.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request after signup — quick fit details

Hi Rachel,

We just signed up via the self-serve flow earlier today (BrightLane). I'm exploring Redwood to power semantic search + short generative replies inside our customer support dashboard. High level: multi-tenant support app, ~50k monthly active users, estimated steady-state ~2M tokens/week with spikes around product launches.

Before we book a full demo, can someone confirm whether Redwood has built-in prefix caching and how you suggest handling a mixed retrieval + generation flow? Also curious about latency targets for 200 concurrent async requests.

Happy to jump on a short demo — looping in our eng lead if needed. I've attached a small traffic export.

Thanks,
Alex Soto
Head of Platform
BrightLane
Attachment: traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request after signup — quick fit details

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the context, appreciate the traffic export. I'm Rachel (AE covering mid-market retail & platform). Quick set of clarifying questions so we tailor the demo and bring the right folks:

- Use case specifics: is the generation step primarily templated responses (structured fields + a short summary) or free-form text?
- Retrieval stack: are you planning an embeddings store (we often integrate with Pinecone/Weaviate) or a DB-backed lookup?
- Concurrency & SLA: when you say ~200 concurrent async requests, is that sustained or burst? Any latency SLO (p95 target)?
- Data residency / privacy: will any of the content require private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or is hosted ok?
- Pilot timeline: aiming for a PoC in 2–4 weeks, or longer?

If it's helpful, here are some times I have this week (all PDT) — or feel free to use my Calendly: https://calendly.com/rachel-kim/30min
- Thu Jul 22 10:00–10:30
- Thu Jul 22 14:00–14:30
- Fri Jul 23 09:30–10:00

I'll loop Ben (solutions engineer) into the demo so we can go deeper on batching, KV caching, and model/quantization choices.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@brightlane.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@brightlane.com>, BrightLane Ops <ops@brightlane.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request after signup — quick fit details

Rachel — thanks, quick answers below:

- Generation: mostly templated responses with a small free-form summary (1–3 sentences). We expect structured fields (issue type, priority) plus a paragraph.
- Retrieval: embeddings-based vector store (we currently use an in-house store, may move to managed later).
- Concurrency: ~200 concurrent is our expected peak during launches (bursts lasting 10–30 minutes), steady-state ~30–50 concurrent. P95 target is <500ms for customer-facing actions.
- Data residency: hosted is fine for now; we'll revisit Private if/when we handle regulated customers.
- Timeline: we'd like a PoC within 3 weeks. Engineering lead Samir (cc'd) will join the demo and can share more telemetry.

Samir, Alex here — can you join Thu Jul 22 at 14:00 PDT or Fri Jul 23 at 09:30 PDT? Either works for our side.

I've attached the traffic snapshot (same CSV).

Thanks,
Alex
Attachment: traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)

Perfect — Thu Jul 22 at 14:00 PDT works for our team. I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute technical demo and include a short agenda:

1) Quick intro + BrightLane use case (5 min)
2) Redwood runtime overview: batching, KV/prefix caching, latency tradeoffs (10 min)
3) Implementation patterns for retrieval + generation + suggested model profiles (10 min)
4) Next steps / PoC plan (5 min)

Ben and I will cover architecture and latency tuning; Stephanie (Growth Lead) will be on to discuss ramp strategy and pilot success criteria. If you want to share any additional telemetry or a small sample of anonymized support tickets ahead of time, that would help us tailor the PoC.

I'll create the invite and include a link to the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/brightlane (so we capture notes and next steps). Expect the invite from me in the next 10 minutes.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
